title: Billing Calendar Note: Part-Month Rate in the First Vacant Month — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**Billing calendar note.** Where an In-Place Home Resale package charges for the vacant-home check, the month's visit charge is multiplied by the part-month rate, and only then is any credit for the month taken off. The part-month rate applies to the month in which the home became vacant: a vacancy that began on the sixteenth day of that month or later is charged at 0.5, a vacancy that began between the second and the fifteenth day of that month is charged at 0.75, and any other month, the home being vacant from its first day, is charged at a rate of one.

The day the home became vacant is the date of the seller's accepted occupancy report on the file, and the rate applies when the month charged is the calendar month of that date.

| Month charged | Day the vacancy began | Part-month rate |
|---|---|---|
| the month the home became vacant | 16th or later | 0.5 |
| the month the home became vacant | 2nd to 15th | 0.75 |
| the month the home became vacant | 1st | 1 |
| any later month | any | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical visit charge of 60.00)

| Accepted occupancy report | Month charged | Rate | Visit charge after the rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 April | April | 0.5 | 30.00 |
| 15 April | April | 0.75 | 45.00 |
| 2 April | April | 0.75 | 45.00 |
| 1 April | April | 1 | 60.00 |
| 16 April | May | 1 | 60.00 |
